question.text: Which of the following BEST represents the alpha-beta separation concept in practice?

answer.text: Long 100% active long-short equity fund + Long 100% S&P 500 futures overlay for beta

explanation.text: The Logic: Portable alpha / alpha-beta separation: run the alpha engine (long-short) independently and overlay beta via futures — effectively 'transporting' alpha from one asset class and beta from another. The Trap: Options B, C, D capture only one of alpha or beta, not both simultaneously. Cross-Exam Context: X-A mentions at product level; XXI-B expects implementation-level grasp. Manager's Pro-Tip: Implementation requires derivative sophistication and collateral management — typically a TRI (total return index) futures program.
